The bar is therefore written from the stakeholder intent rather than from the test, because a test written by the builder encodes the builder&#x27;s own idea of usable. The two-carrier split has no recorded rationale and costs on both sides. Reading 32 need rows takes ~166 code lines across 14 functions in 8 modules - six bespoke scanners, two of them F5 twins pinned by nothing but a docstring, which have already drifted once and rendered a phantom root in the dashboard - while reading all 436 SR+LLR+TC rows takes csv.DictReader. CSV also cannot represent the cells that actually exist: five hold a literal pipe, 552 hold commas, the longest is 1,553 characters, and an embedded newline has no representation at all. A structured carrier turns three integrity rules into properties of the parse - a duplicate id becomes a decode error, a ref list becomes a typed array (retiring the split-on-whitespace rule that read `and` as an orphan), and an empty cell becomes an absent key, so `unset` and `set to empty` stop being the same value. The converter is the migration&#x27;s evidence, not its convenience: SR-129&#x27;s 140-cell lesson is that an unproven representation change is exactly where a registry silently loses cells.  copy recording its acceptance - stakeholder needs included, despite their
 carrying no status cell - regardless of any Status movement.</p></div></div><div class="field"><span class="k">Rationale</span><div class="v"><p>THE DRIFT half, separable from SR-140 in the direction that matters: a record that exists and rides its approval commit, with nothing ever comparing live text against it, satisfies SR-140 completely and leaves every later amendment invisible. That is not a hypothetical - it is precisely the failure the git-history derivation had, and the reason a baseline on disk was owed at all.
 REGARDLESS OF STATUS MOVEMENT is the load-bearing clause, not a qualifier. The amendment machinery watches the Status flip, and the sanctioned staged-amendment path deliberately does not flip - so a rule keyed off the flip returns nothing on exactly the rows a sitting exists to judge. Reporting against the recorded copy is the only reading that survives that, because the copy is a baseline OUTSIDE the live file and a walk over the live file can never be one.

+_approved — re-attestation owed_
 - **Method**
   - before: The verdict record's two halves, each driven beside its opposite so neither reads as a rule with one answer. THE IDENTITY, pure over synthetic `git ls-tree -r` entries: a listing and the same listing plus a round file, a log fragment and a session log fold EQUAL, while a changed work blob and a changed docs/work/ spec each fold DIFFERENT - so the exclusion is proven to be an exclusion rather than a fold that ignores everything. THE ENCODING BOUNDARY, driven through git rather than asserted about it: a record path holding a non-ASCII character - the shape git QUOTES, asserted in the fixture so it cannot silently stop reproducing - leaves the identity unmoved, while an accented WORK path moves it; and raw listings with one blob renamed from invalid-UTF-8 path byte 200 to 201 - asserted to COLLIDE under replacement decoding - fold DIFFERENT through tree_identity, so parsing and the ASCII record-prefix boundary occur before any decode. THE TRAILER GRAMMAR: format/parse round-trip; the LAST trailer in a message governs, so a rework commit quoting the round it answers does not have the quotation read as its own attestation; and three malformed shapes - a verdict word outside the enum, a 40-hex tree, a missing round count - each fail to PARSE rather than parse to something. THE NAME PARSE: a round file with and without the relaxed tag, the pre-train flat layout, a session log, and the legacy hand-authored rollup answering None because it names no reviewed sha. THE GATE, on a two-branch git fixture with the trunk checked out: a logged reviewer round naming the current tree clears it with NO rollup present anywhere; the same file with a BUILD session log behind it does not (the implementer-authored round); a SECOND round file committed behind that ONE session log, whose NAME claims the other declared phase, is not a second reviewer - both files are asserted committed and the single log with them, the entries carry the LOG's phase, so at a declared policy of 2 REVIEW-B is still outstanding and the gate refuses by name until a REVIEW-B whose own session log declares it arrives and clears it; TWO session logs at ONE (train, ordinal) declaring DIFFERENT review phases - both asserted committed, with the round file they would otherwise phase asserted still present so the empty answer is the ambiguity rule and not an empty scan - serve NO round at all rather than letting the last log read win, and the gate refuses by name while the single-log arm beside it clears; a round whose tree was reworked away does not, while a log-fragment and scoreboard commit after a round leaves it governing; a CHANGES-REQUESTED round refuses; and a verified Review-Verdict trailer contradicting the rounds refuses by name in its verdict word and in a round count ABOVE the evidence, while a count BELOW it does NOT - both directions driven, because the writer is best-effort and a stamp the evidence outruns is a missed stamp whose refusal parked an approved lane at the very stop the cross-check exists to prevent - and TWO attestations at one governing tree leave the NEWEST governing so a legitimately re-drawn round is not accused of forgery. THE CARRIER IS VERIFIED AND NOT ONLY PARSED, which is what "the trailer cannot create an approval" costs: the identical attestation words on a commit that CHANGED the work under them - asserted in the fixture to have really moved the governing identity - are read at neither the tree they NAME nor the tree they rode, beside the record-only carrier of the same words that IS read, so copying a true attestation onto later work buys nothing. THE WRITER IS DRIVEN END TO END, not only the trailer helper: a completed round is run through the loop's own complete_review_round on a repository fixture and the commit it lands is asserted to CARRY the attestation, to name the governing tree, to be read back by the branch reader under the key the cross-check looks up, to leave that governing tree unmoved, and to satisfy the gate - the whole path between a round completing and its attestation landing, which every other trailer case skipped by committing the string itself, and which nothing anywhere reports when it stops writing because absence is the state the cross-check must stand down on. THE RESUME'S OWED SET IS THE EVIDENCE'S ALONE: with both declared phases served at the governing tree and a stale untracked owed-marker still present - the state a run killed between the last reviewer's commit and the round completing leaves - the resume is asserted to queue NOTHING, and beside it a genuine rework with one phase redrawn is asserted to queue that phase and only it. THE PEEL: a genuine Bar-Green refresh commit, verified against its own tree and parent, moves the branch tip's identity and neither reader's answer - the loop still says no round is owed and the gate still merges - which is the one commit class two separately-chosen revs disagreed on; and the same refresh with a coordinator TELEMETRY commit stacked on top of it - a record path, so the fold ignores it and only the tip-only peel could be defeated by it - still owes no round and still merges. THE SECOND DISPOSABLE CLASS, the machinery's own MECHANICAL adjudication close admitted by mechanical_close_attestation, is driven beside it in the same idiom - the positive and its subject/path refusals - so the peel reads as a verified ADMISSION and not as a subject match. The positive: a mechanical close written through the composed close subject and touching only docs/work/ is asserted to REALLY have moved the branch's tree - without which the test would pass on a peel that had nothing to do - and the round it follows still governs and still merges, with no legacy rollup present anywhere so the migration window is not what cleared it; without that peel the close archiving a judged row stales the APPROVE that had just judged it, which is the failure this arm exists for and the one an adjudication lane cannot avoid by ordering, since its round is drawn while the row is still in active/. The two peels are then driven COMPOSING, a station refresh stacked on the close, because a lane produces them in that order. The refusals, and every one of them is driven with the OTHER clauses satisfied, so each is the single thing that turns its commit away. A close carrying a HAND-WRITTEN subject is an ordinary work commit and does not peel; a commit with the PUBLIC mechanical prefix/suffix but a FORGED middle is refused because the attestor derives the actual active/ -> complete/ WI ids from the no-renames git diff and re-composes their exact canonical subject; a close carrying the machinery's own subject that also touched a path OUTSIDE docs/work/ does not peel either; and INSIDE docs/work/ is not enough, because only the move itself may create or destroy - a close that SMUGGLED a brand-new spec in beside the move, and a close that DESTROYED an already-terminal archived record beside it, are each refused, since peeling either would measure a spec's injection or a judged row's deletion at the parent where no reviewer ever saw it. A close whose pairs came out of a SECOND lane's active/ directory is refused by the one-source-branch requirement, driven with everything else valid - paths confined, deletions paired with their own additions, the subject exactly the one the writer composes for those ids - so nothing but that clause can be answering. THE BATCH SHAPE is driven too, because it is the only one on which the writer's id order and the order the attestor re-derives from the diff could disagree: a TWO-row close, seeded in deliberately NON-canonical order, is asserted to peel to the judged rev, and the shared ordering helper is asserted to reorder them and to compose a subject the reversed order does not, so the arm cannot pass on a tie. All the refusal arms are asserted to leave the gate refusing BY NAME on the round no longer naming the current tree, which is the fail-toward-MORE-review direction every unverified identity-moving step here takes. THE WRITER IS DRIVEN AGAINST THE VERIFIER, not only against fixtures the test file composes itself: a REAL close is landed through handback.close_adjudication and the commit it produces is asserted to peel back to exactly the rev the lane was on, so an ordering or a spelling that drifted on either side is a red rather than a silently un-peelable close on every adjudication lane. THE EMPTY CLOSE is driven where it is OBSERVABLE and its consequence is stated rather than assumed to match the others: a commit carrying the composed subject and a single parent that changed NOTHING - a real --allow-empty commit, since a zero-path diff is the one close shape a fixture cannot reach by writing files - is asserted refused AT mechanical_close_attestation, and deliberately NOT asserted at the gate, because measurement says the gate cannot see this refusal at all. Its refusal is OVER-DETERMINED and no clause owns it, which is stated rather than glossed: the one-source-branch requirement turns it away first, and with THAT deleted the empty diff derives no ids at all, whose composed subject (`adjudicate:  -> complete/ (mechanical close)`) cannot equal the one the commit carries - so the exact-subject comparison refuses it regardless, and there is deliberately no third non-emptiness clause, which could only ever fire where these two already had. The consequence is asserted beside the refusal because they are the honest pair: an empty commit preserves the identity by construction, so governing_rev's walk-through step reaches the real close underneath either way, and a test asserting a gate refusal here would be asserting a behaviour the module does not have and should not, since a commit that changed nothing has invalidated no verdict. THE TWO PEELS' REFUSAL ARMS are held by tests/test_integrate_station.py, cited beside this module because integrate re-exports these very functions (refresh_attestation, work_tip) and the station suite is where a refresh can be produced rather than hand-written: a genuine refresh attested to the sha it produced; a forged Bar-Green trailer in three shapes, the sharpest being a genuine refresh message copied verbatim onto another commit; an amend that keeps the message while the tree moves, revoking the attestation; the deliberately forged attestation recorded as a STATED limit rather than a defence; and the reset peel's data-loss half - an honest work commit merely QUOTING the trailer is never peeled away, and a genuine refresh above it peels back to exactly that commit. BOTH carriers are driven, not only the convenient one: that non-empty telemetry commit, and then the EMPTY commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes when a Review-Verdict attestation must land on unchanged bookkeeping - obtained by CALLING that producer rather than by hand, so the two cannot drift apart, and asserted to really be zero-path, because that is the commit shape a walk classifying PATHS could not classify and so stopped at, burying the refresh under the very commit that recorded the approval. A WORK commit above the refresh does re-owe and does refuse, so the walk is proven to step through what cannot invalidate a verdict rather than through everything. BOTH ORDERS of refresh and round, because only one of them was covered and the other was broken: the round drawn AFTER the refresh - the order the shipped path actually produces, since a lane's refresh is spawned as soon as its worker is DONE and before the merge slot runs, so any slot refusal parks a branch with a refresh and no round - cites the POST-refresh sha, asserted in the fixture to be that sha and not the pre-refresh one, and is asserted to serve the lane at both readers and to carry the coordinator's attestation under the key the cross-check looks it up by, while a rework above it still re-owes. THE ATTESTATION'S CARRIER IS SCOPED TO ITS OWN PATHS, on BOTH arms and not only the one that carries a pathspec: with an unrelated work file staged and the bookkeeping unchanged, the commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes for NAMED paths and the one it writes for NO paths at all - the call this suite itself makes, and the arm where a scope appended only when paths exist evaporates - are each asserted zero-path with the caller's index left exactly as found, so work cannot land under a bookkeeping label nor an attestation ride a commit that changed the tree. THE DIAL: the three values over a brief-and-drafts matrix, an unrecognized value falling to when-minting rather than to never, and an adjudication lane closing with a successor draft merging with no verdict artifact of any kind under both never and when-minting, while a spine draft still owes its round. THE DIAL AT THE SCHEDULER, the half a reader could otherwise only take on trust: a committing ADJUDICATE session is driven through the loop's own bookkeeping arm on a closed-lane repository at every dial value - including the `always` no repository fixture had reached - and the review queue it leaves is asserted together with the train-scoped diff range and the recorded judging family, which is what "exactly as a committing BUILD does" has to mean. Its INPUT is driven beside it: a branch carrying its spec in BOTH homes, the terminal copy drafting a spine successor and a stale active copy an ordinary one, is asserted to answer the scheduler and the merge gate the SAME way, with the shared precedence also driven pure on a two-path list and on the empty one. THE SHARED DEFINITION, in BOTH its dimensions. WHICH TREE: the C2 review-owed derivation answers owed after a rework and served after a fresh round, and record-only commits after the verdict re-owe nothing. HOW MANY PHASES: at a declared policy of 2 a lone logged REVIEW-A APPROVE is REFUSED by name and the gate clears only once a governing REVIEW-B joins it at the same identity; and the half-drawn round a killed run leaves - REVIEW-A served, the in-memory phase queue gone - is answered by both readers together, the derivation naming REVIEW-B and ONLY REVIEW-B while the gate refuses, then both agreeing once it lands, with the same fixture asserted SERVED at policy 1 so the answer is proven to come from the declared count. The phase span is driven pure at the values neither caller reaches - a negative policy, which a bare slice would answer by slicing from the END, and an over-dialled one - and the one class the two readers must disagree on is pinned: a drawn but UNPARSEABLE verdict is not re-drawn and does not clear the gate either. THE TIER IS THE WHOLE CITED SET'S, not the majority's: 9 of these citations sit in test_integrate_admission, test_integrate_station and test_handback, all three named in tests/conftest.py SLOW_MODULES and so deselected by `-m smoke`, so Full is the cheapest tier at which EVERY arm above actually runs and Smoke would have claimed commit-floor coverage for a set the commit floor only partly runs. THE GATE, on a two-branch git fixture with the trunk checked out: a logged reviewer round naming the current tree clears it with NO rollup present anywhere; the same file with a BUILD session log behind it does not (the implementer-authored round); a SECOND round file committed behind that ONE session log, whose NAME claims the other declared phase, is not a second reviewer - both files are asserted committed and the single log with them, the entries carry the LOG's phase, so at a declared policy of 2 REVIEW-B is still outstanding and the gate refuses by name until a REVIEW-B whose own session log declares it arrives and clears it; TWO session logs at ONE (train, ordinal) declaring DIFFERENT review phases - both asserted committed, with the round file they would otherwise phase asserted still present so the empty answer is the ambiguity rule and not an empty scan - serve NO round at all rather than letting the last log read win, and the gate refuses by name while the single-log arm beside it clears; a round whose tree was reworked away does not, while a log-fragment and scoreboard commit after a round leaves it governing; a CHANGES-REQUESTED round refuses; and a verified Review-Verdict trailer contradicting the rounds refuses by name in its verdict word and in a round count ABOVE the evidence, while a count BELOW it does NOT - both directions driven, because the writer is best-effort and a stamp the evidence outruns is a missed stamp whose refusal parked an approved lane at the very stop the cross-check exists to prevent - and TWO attestations at one governing tree leave the NEWEST governing so a legitimately re-drawn round is not accused of forgery. THE CARRIER IS VERIFIED AND NOT ONLY PARSED, which is what "the trailer cannot create an approval" costs: the identical attestation words on a commit that CHANGED the work under them - asserted in the fixture to have really moved the governing identity - are read at neither the tree they NAME nor the tree they rode, beside the record-only carrier of the same words that IS read, so copying a true attestation onto later work buys nothing. THE WRITER IS DRIVEN END TO END, not only the trailer helper: a completed round is run through the loop's own complete_review_round on a repository fixture and the commit it lands is asserted to CARRY the attestation, to name the governing tree, to be read back by the branch reader under the key the cross-check looks up, to leave that governing tree unmoved, and to satisfy the gate - the whole path between a round completing and its attestation landing, which every other trailer case skipped by committing the string itself, and which nothing anywhere reports when it stops writing because absence is the state the cross-check must stand down on. THE RESUME'S OWED SET IS THE EVIDENCE'S ALONE: with both declared phases served at the governing tree and a stale untracked owed-marker still present - the state a run killed between the last reviewer's commit and the round completing leaves - the resume is asserted to queue NOTHING, and beside it a genuine rework with one phase redrawn is asserted to queue that phase and only it. THE PEEL: a genuine Bar-Green refresh commit, verified against its own tree and parent, moves the branch tip's identity and neither reader's answer - the loop still says no round is owed and the gate still merges - which is the one commit class two separately-chosen revs disagreed on; and the same refresh with a coordinator TELEMETRY commit stacked on top of it - a record path, so the fold ignores it and only the tip-only peel could be defeated by it - still owes no round and still merges. THE PRIMARY ADJUDICATION CARRIER: drive its stage-only writer against the verifier. Exact reviewed Approval bytes, accepted Status/snapshot effects, spec_move close transformation, successor specs, watermark and declared generated bytes carry the review from candidate to final tree; forged subject, wrong WI/turn, stale proposal or candidate, extra/missing path, cross-WI close, malformed successor, partial snapshot and unreviewed decision each fail toward more review. Kill before and after the atomic commit and prove pending resume versus one derived completion and no duplicate mint. THE TWO PEELS' REFUSAL ARMS are held by tests/test_integrate_station.py, cited beside this module because integrate re-exports these very functions (refresh_attestation, work_tip) and the station suite is where a refresh can be produced rather than hand-written: a genuine refresh attested to the sha it produced; a forged Bar-Green trailer in three shapes, the sharpest being a genuine refresh message copied verbatim onto another commit; an amend that keeps the message while the tree moves, revoking the attestation; the deliberately forged attestation recorded as a STATED limit rather than a defence; and the reset peel's data-loss half - an honest work commit merely QUOTING the trailer is never peeled away, and a genuine refresh above it peels back to exactly that commit. BOTH carriers are driven, not only the convenient one: that non-empty telemetry commit, and then the EMPTY commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes when a Review-Verdict attestation must land on unchanged bookkeeping - obtained by CALLING that producer rather than by hand, so the two cannot drift apart, and asserted to really be zero-path, because that is the commit shape a walk classifying PATHS could not classify and so stopped at, burying the refresh under the very commit that recorded the approval. A WORK commit above the refresh does re-owe and does refuse, so the walk is proven to step through what cannot invalidate a verdict rather than through everything. BOTH ORDERS of refresh and round, because only one of them was covered and the other was broken: the round drawn AFTER the refresh - the order the shipped path actually produces, since a lane's refresh is spawned as soon as its worker is DONE and before the merge slot runs, so any slot refusal parks a branch with a refresh and no round - cites the POST-refresh sha, asserted in the fixture to be that sha and not the pre-refresh one, and is asserted to serve the lane at both readers and to carry the coordinator's attestation under the key the cross-check looks it up by, while a rework above it still re-owes. THE ATTESTATION'S CARRIER IS SCOPED TO ITS OWN PATHS, on BOTH arms and not only the one that carries a pathspec: with an unrelated work file staged and the bookkeeping unchanged, the commit agent_common.commit_telemetry writes for NAMED paths and the one it writes for NO paths at all - the call this suite itself makes, and the arm where a scope appended only when paths exist evaporates - are each asserted zero-path with the caller's index left exactly as found, so work cannot land under a bookkeeping label nor an attestation ride a commit that changed the tree. THE DIAL: the three values over a brief-and-drafts matrix, an unrecognized value falling to when-minting rather than to never, and a primary adjudication turn closing with successor drafts publishing with no verdict artifact of any kind under both never and when-minting, while a spine draft still owes its round. THE DIAL AT THE SCHEDULER, the half a reader could otherwise only take on trust: a committing ADJUDICATE session is driven through the loop's own bookkeeping arm on a pending primary-turn repository at every dial value - including the `always` no repository fixture had reached - and the review queue it leaves is asserted together with the train-scoped diff range and the recorded judging family, which is what "exactly as a committing BUILD does" has to mean. Its INPUT is driven beside it: a queued adjudication spec with one bound pending turn, followed by the terminal spec and verified publication, is asserted to answer the scheduler and verdict reader consistently; ordinary branches retain the shared terminal-before-active precedence, driven pure on a two-path list and on the empty one. THE SHARED DEFINITION, in BOTH its dimensions. WHICH TREE: the C2 review-owed derivation answers owed after a rework and served after a fresh round, and record-only commits after the verdict re-owe nothing. HOW MANY PHASES: at a declared policy of 2 a lone logged REVIEW-A APPROVE is REFUSED by name and the gate clears only once a governing REVIEW-B joins it at the same identity; and the half-drawn round a killed run leaves - REVIEW-A served, the in-memory phase queue gone - is answered by both readers together, the derivation naming REVIEW-B and ONLY REVIEW-B while the gate refuses, then both agreeing once it lands, with the same fixture asserted SERVED at policy 1 so the answer is proven to come from the declared count. The phase span is driven pure at the values neither caller reaches - a negative policy, which a bare slice would answer by slicing from the END, and an over-dialled one - and the one class the two readers must disagree on is pinned: a drawn but UNPARSEABLE verdict is not re-drawn and does not clear the gate either. THE TIER IS THE WHOLE CITED SET'S, not the majority's: the cited integration-station, primary-approval and primary-publication cases include modules named in tests/conftest.py SLOW_MODULES and so deselected by `-m smoke`, so Full is the cheapest tier at which EVERY arm above actually runs and Smoke would have claimed commit-floor coverage for a set the commit floor only partly runs. Tier and the pytest marker remain independent declarations that no check compares (registry-machinery-reference §12.2); this cell is labelled on the side that under-claims.

+def supersedes_ids(value):
+    """A draft's `supersedes` as an ORDERED, de-duplicated list of ids.
+
+    ONE id or SEVERAL, in one reader (the 2026-09-02 restructure plan §1.5).
+    Every disposition names exactly one predecessor and writes it as a bare
+    string; a CONSOLIDATION absorbs several rows into one successor and writes a
+    TOML list. Both spellings arrive here and leave as a list, so nothing
+    downstream — the cell, the edge re-point, the refusals — has two shapes to
+    handle. An absent or empty value is an empty list, which is what "this row
+    continues nothing" means.
+
+    A STRING is SPLIT, because the writer's own form is a joined one:
+    `_draft_row` stores the cell as `";".join(supersedes_ids(...))`, so a minted
+    spec carries `supersedes = "WI-558;WI-560"` — and a reader that took that
+    back as ONE token would hand `_supersedes_refusal` a value it must reject as
+    "not a WI-### id", which is a writer emitting what its own sibling reader
+    refuses. The writer's form round-trips through the reader; that is the rule.
+
+    ONE separator, `;`, and it is the WRITER's: this split exists to read a
+    machine-written cell back, never to parse an author's prose. A hand-authored
+    `## Dispositions` block is held to the stricter spelling at its own boundary
+    (`_authored_supersedes_refusal`: a string is exactly one id, several ids are
+    a TOML list), so nothing that reaches here needs a second separator class.
+
+    Deliberately NOT `kitlib.spine.refs`, the shared multi-ref splitter, though
+    this is otherwise exactly its job: `refs` also splits on WHITESPACE, and a
+    `supersedes` naming free prose ("the other one") would then reach the
+    refusal as three tokens, so the message could no longer echo the author's
+    own value back at them."""
+    if value is None:
+        return []
+    items = value if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)) else [value]
+    out = []
+    for item in items:
+        for token in str(item).split(";"):
+            token = token.strip()
+            if token and token not in out:
+                out.append(token)
+    return out
+
+

+    return set(supersedes_ids(_cell(row, "Supersedes")))
